title: Rajasthan Is Bigger Than All but Six Countries in Europe

beats.say: By the United Nations' list of Europe, Rajasthan is bigger than all but six of its countries.
beats.caption: Rajasthan: bigger than all but 6 European countries (UN list)

beats.say: It covers about three hundred and forty-two thousand square kilometres.
beats.caption: Rajasthan: 342,239 km²

beats.say: Only Russia, Ukraine, France, Spain, Sweden and Germany are larger.
beats.caption: Larger: Russia · Ukraine · France · Spain · Sweden · Germany

beats.say: Germany is just four and a half percent bigger, and Finland one percent smaller.
beats.caption: Germany +4.5% · Finland −1.1%

beats.say: So Rajasthan fits in a gap: no European country lies between Finland and Germany.
beats.caption: Nothing between Finland and Germany

beats.say: Norway depends on the definition: its mainland is smaller, but with Svalbard it is bigger.
beats.caption: Norway: mainland smaller · with Svalbard, bigger

beats.say: Bigger than all but six, measured the same way.
beats.caption: Total area, one basis for every country
